_doc: Measured from the live en-US 'I am - Daily Affirmations' (id 874656917) screenshots, 9 slides, 1242x2688 (APP_IPHONE_65), fetched 2026-11-11 14:35 JST via iTunes lookup screenshotUrls at max size. Measurement script: anicca-aso/v2tools/measure.py; raw per-slide numbers in anicca-aso/iam-live/measurements.json. All coordinates in px at base canvas 1242x2688; other sizes scale uniformly by k = width/1242.

Sora 575@112 (v2 draft) had ascender 82 (-5px) so was rejected. Final render: 120px / wght 725 = best joint fit of measured x-height (with overshoot, same measurer) and ascender, both within 2px.
headline.baseline_method: first row below rows whose ink count >= 35% of the line median (measure.py)
